findings.claim: 10-K 揭露無單一客戶占2025、2024、2023年淨銷售超過10%，客戶為數百家。
findings.excerpt: We have hundreds of customers in the various industries that we serve. No customer accounted for more than 10% of our total net sales during 2025, 2024, or 2023.

findings.claim: 商用航太主要客戶為Boeing與Airbus；10-K風險因素提到部分最大客戶可能自製而與公司競爭。
findings.excerpt: Our primary focus is OEM products and services for commercial jets, which represent approximately 90% of our sales in this market and are highly dependent on new aircraft production from our primary customers, Boeing and Airbus.
